findings.message: L301: 🔴 bug: `Files.notExists(resource)` is the opposite of `!Files.exists(resource)`. Use `Files.notExists(resource)` which returns true if the file does not exist (including when it cannot be determined), but the original condition was `!Files.exists(resource)`. This could mis-handle cases where existence is unknown (e.g., permission issues). Keep the original `if (resource == null || !Files.exists(resource))` logic.
